classification.present: Correct hardware/variant or software prerequisite exists; compile/link/API/runtime compatibility remains UNVERIFIED.
classification.variant-mismatch: Original component addresses a different hardware variant. Keep negative checks; never add false aliases.
classification.absent: Native peripheral or external-device prerequisite absent from this inventory; not a compiler result.
classification.new: Custom candidate component or documented hardware/mode with no matching original-release component.

semantics.paths: Original component file/source/header paths are exact archive-entry names inside the specified pack; prefix baseline/ only for a working-tree path. New rows explicitly identify candidate ownership.
semantics.components: Every original HAL Drivers component in every original release PDSC is preserved, including duplicate r_doc occurrences and the two CAVP packs. Every file attribute and regular-file hash is retained; no source is filtered by current MDF visibility, compiler/core or default-off settings.
semantics.module_id: First MDF factory for simple consumers; module_ids/mdf_modules retains every alternate factory. Per-factory classification overrides apply only to that alternate, not the entire driver.
semantics.dependencies: Exact original requires attributes/children retain optional/find semantics; component conditions retain their condition trees. Original kernel/heap/common components and complete PDSC files follow separately.
semantics.generated_inputs: Configuration header paths and factory IDs are prerequisites, not stubs to synthesize. Add correct factories through the configurator with original dependency stacks/kernel headers and real generated vectors.
semantics.verification: This census performs no IDE, pack mutation, source compilation, linking or hardware operations. No present/new row means passed.
semantics.hardware_crosscheck: HM chapters 1–69 plus function comparison and Appendix 5 are independent of current candidate MDF provides; KxxCAC dual-core part selected.
semantics.stack_monitor: HM 16.1 Table 16.1 lists Arm and bus-master MPUs, not the old vendor R_MPU_SPMON. Arm stack limits do not justify fabricating that unit; unsupported RTOS vendor-stack-monitor settings must be rejected explicitly.
semantics.source_selection: source_paths is the complete original PDSC source-category union, not a command to compile every file in every fixture. The gate requires this union to match components.files, intersects it with each real generated compile database, and excludes compiler-specific non-GNU ports under GCC (including tx_iar.c). Unselected paths remain explicit fixture gaps, never fabricated configurations or inactive compile passes.
semantics.first_factory: module_id is the first factory as shipped, not a guarantee that it is creatable for RA8P1. Select any applicable module_ids entry after checking its original MDF requires; no current candidate provides were used as a census filter.
semantics.source_gate: After uses current owning baseline/ra/fsp BSP/header bytes in disposable project copies, not installed pack/project BSP copies. Before uses immutable before-inputs.zip. Generated ra_cfg/ra_gen and real CMSIS/kernel/dependency trees stay byte-identical. Stock removes candidate-only HAL/API/instance files and uses hash-verified original PDSC-owned component source/header bytes; candidate is a separate gate. Compiler dependency manifests prove which BSP/header was consumed and hash every successful compile input.
semantics.coverage_gate: Aggregate multiple --project fixtures independently for stock and candidate and for each required core (default CM85 and CM33). Only active selected translation units can establish coverage. A real selected-fixture compile failure is never hidden by another passing fixture. Missing generated fixtures, header/library-only rows and unimplemented hardware/modes remain blocked; manual absent and variant-mismatch rows are report-only, not compatibility passes. Exit 0 means complete required source coverage with no failures, 1 includes compile failures, and 2 means blocked/incomplete coverage (also argparse usage errors).
semantics.historical_attempts: before-*.json, exhaustive-working.json and other retained reports are immutable historical attempts. Legacy ADC/SCI/DAC and other wrong-variant errors are negative evidence, not correct-variant failures or proof of compatibility. Schema-2 source-gate reports do not overwrite or reinterpret their raw diagnostics.
